subject: planner: optimize for full range (#66304)
summary: Reviewed this commit’s planner changes vs first parent: (1) cardinality now short-circuits index rowcount estimation to `RealtimeCount` only when ranges include a true full-range including NULLs and the index is neither partial nor MV; (2) skyline-pruning candidate comparisons cache `eqOrInCount` and full-range checks; (3) table-path stats skip the expensive rowcount path only when `Ranges` is non-empty. No remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantics/consistency/compatibility issues found in these planner changes, and later upstream history shows follow-up planner work but no evidence of a required fix for a Blocker/High issue introduced here.
